description: Stable synthetic identifier for a project.
notes: Use for group-aware splits.

description: Month-end date of the snapshot.
notes: Composite key with project_id.

description: Synthetic project name.
notes: Not a model feature; free text only.

description: Synthetic implementing agency.
notes: Categorical; encode before modelling.

description: Infrastructure sector.
notes: Categorical.

description: Indian state/UT of the project.
notes: Categorical.

description: Project status as of the observation date.
source_or_formula: Completed if actual_end_date set; Delayed if overdue or schedule revised; else Ongoing
notes: Derived from as-of state only.

description: Originally approved cost.
notes: Fixed for the project's life.

description: Latest revised cost approved on or before the observation date.
source_or_formula: Set at each cost revision event
notes: NULL means no revision has happened yet - do not impute with 0.

description: Cost baseline currently in force.
Cumulative expenditure to date.
source_or_formula: Simulated from progress, escalation and front-loading
notes: Monotonic non-decreasing.

description: Approved start date.
Currently approved completion date (after any schedule revisions to date).
source_or_formula: Original end + approved extensions up to observation_date

description: Completion date in the original sanction.
notes: Baseline for the time-overrun target.

description: Actual physical start.
notes: NULL if the project had not started by the observation date.

description: Actual completion date.
notes: NULL unless the project had already completed on or before the observation date. NEVER back-filled - that would be leakage.

description: Physical progress the current approved schedule implies for this date.
notes: Uses the CURRENT approved schedule, so it resets after a schedule revision.

description: Reported physical progress.
notes: 0-100, non-decreasing within a project.

description: Total milestones in the project plan.
Milestones completed by the observation date.
Milestones that should have been completed by now but are not.
Slippage visible as of this date.
notes: Contains no future information.

description: Gap to the previous available snapshot of this project.
notes: NULL on the first observation. >1 indicates a reporting gap.

description: Expenditure at the previous available snapshot.
notes: NULL on the first observation.

description: Growth in cumulative expenditure since the previous snapshot.
notes: NULL on first observation or zero base.

description: Physical progress at the previous available snapshot.
notes: NULL on the first observation.

description: Change in physical progress since the previous snapshot.
notes: Percentage POINTS, not percent, to avoid divide-by-zero at 0 progress.

description: Cost revisions approved up to this date.
Schedule extensions approved up to this date.
Escalation of the approved cost so far.
Share of the applicable budget already spent.
notes: May exceed 100 shortly before a revision is approved.

description: Schedule shortfall in physical terms.
notes: Positive means behind schedule.

description: Physical work left.
Earned-value cost performance index.
notes: <1 means spending faster than value earned. NULL when expenditure is 0.

description: Earned-value schedule performance index.
notes: <1 means behind schedule. NULL when planned_progress is 0.

description: Budget consumed per unit of physical progress.
notes: NULL at 0 progress.

description: Extension granted so far.
Delay in physical start.
notes: NULL if not yet started.

description: Original sanctioned duration.
Duration under the current approved schedule.
Days since the planned start.
Days since the actual start.
notes: NULL if not yet started.

description: Days to the current approved completion date.
notes: Negative when overdue.

description: Slippage relative to the original duration.
Share of the current schedule consumed.
Total approved revisions to date.
Share of milestones completed.
Share of milestones overdue.
Annualised rate of approved-cost escalation.
notes: NULL for projects younger than 60 days or not started.

description: 1-based index of this snapshot within the project.
Calendar year of the snapshot.
Calendar month of the snapshot.
Eventual total approved cost against the ORIGINAL sanction.
notes: Same value on every snapshot of a project (project-level outcome).

description: Further escalation still to come after the observation date.
notes: Varies across snapshots; the more useful regression target for an as-of forecast.

description: Whether the project eventually overruns its original cost by >10%.
notes: Threshold 10% is a documented modelling choice, not an official definition.

description: Eventual completion delay against the original plan.
notes: Negative means early completion.

description: Delay relative to the original duration.
Whether the eventual delay exceeds 10% of the original duration.
notes: Threshold 10% is a documented modelling choice.

description: Composite outcome-based risk score for the project.
notes: Deterministic function of simulated outcomes. Project-level.

description: Banded risk level.
Whether a deterioration event occurs within 92 days after this observation.
source_or_formula: 1 if a new cost revision OR a new schedule revision is approved, OR progress_gap widens by >=8 percentage points, within the next 92 days
notes: Row-level forward-looking label. See README caveat on optimistic performance.

description: Whether the project's outcome occurs after the 2026-05-31 snapshot cutoff.
source_or_formula: 1 if the project had not completed by the cutoff
notes: In a real deployment these projects would have NO label yet. Useful for a realistic labelled-subset experiment.

description: Suggested group-aware split.
notes: All snapshots of a project fall in one split.

description: Suggested time-based split.
notes: Use with care: the same project appears in several splits at different ages.
